---

**Security issue? Stop and follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md). Do not
disclose vulnerabilities publicly.**

## Component and environment

Identify the component, revision, operating system, language/runtime version,
and relevant dependency versions.

## Input

Provide the smallest safely shareable input. Do not include private,
third-party, or security-sensitive data.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead, including exact output or diagnostics?

## Reproduction

List deterministic reproduction steps and checks already run.

## Contract comparison

Which specification, schema, fixture, or documented behavior supports the
expectation? An SDK or tool bug is not automatically a specification bug.
